layer_definitions.independence_note: Price series is an external economic context and does not measure attention.

layer_definitions.independence_note: Official price index; revisions and basket definitions must be retained.
layer_definitions.label: ONS consumer prices

layer_definitions.independence_note: Gridded physical conditions are separate from event catalogues and media.
layer_definitions.label: HadUK-Grid weather anomalies

layer_definitions.access_requirement: public feed; confirm geography and update semantics
layer_definitions.independence_note: Operational alert feed can overlap with media reporting.
layer_definitions.label: Environment Agency flood alerts

layer_definitions.independence_note: Operational disruption may be both a news subject and an exposure.
layer_definitions.label: Rail disruption and performance

layer_definitions.access_requirement: confirm source terms and delayed data
layer_definitions.independence_note: Market series is not a direct UK household price measure.
layer_definitions.label: Brent crude oil price

layer_definitions.independence_note: Market context is exploratory and not a causal control by default.
layer_definitions.label: FTSE 100 index

layer_definitions.access_requirement: approve local feed inventory and geography mapping
layer_definitions.independence_note: Must distinguish incident location, audience geography and article-mentioned geography.
layer_definitions.label: Local disruption register

layer_definitions.access_requirement: T&E API access and publication terms
layer_definitions.independence_note: Search interest remains separate from news and social measures.
layer_definitions.label: Official Google Trends search interest

layer_definitions.access_requirement: T&E-owned API key for durable refresh
layer_definitions.independence_note: Hotspots are detections, not named events or burned area.
layer_definitions.label: NASA FIRMS active fires

layer_definitions.independence_note: Burned area is separate from FIRMS hotspots and GDACS events.
layer_definitions.label: NASA MODIS MCD64 burned area
